message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) based on facts.

Facts: Liu Moujia carried fire paper, lighter to perform ancestor worship, accidentally set forest on fire, causing forest fire of 99.1 mu (approx 6.6 hectares). He then called relatives to report, tried to extinguish, got caught. This is a case of arson? In Chinese criminal law, causing forest fire is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (reckless endangerment of public safety) or "放火" (arson). The correction lessons include a label "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". Also there is a label "放火". In earlier examples, they used "放火" for intentional setting fire to property (e.g., Wu case). For accidental fire due to negligence, they used "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". Let's see examples: earlier, there is a case: "危害公共安全" example: "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". In the list, there is a label "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". Also there is "放火". Which is appropriate? The facts: He burned fire paper, causing forest fire. He didn't intend to set fire, but negligence. So the crime is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". The correction lessons mention "危险物品肇事" for explosion, "危险驾驶" for traffic, etc. For forest fire, typical charge is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". So answer: [罪名]过失以危险方法危害公共安全<eoa>.

Check if any other label needed: maybe "非法占有"? No. So single label.

Thus final JSON.
